```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(reshape)

```

```{r}
##Read in edit efficiency data for barcode pool 1, plot. 

Edit_Efficiency_MW <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/FigS10_Final_Figure_Datasets/MW_Edit_Efficiency_Comparison_Table.csv") %>% 
  filter(BC_Pool == 1)


ggplot(Edit_Efficiency_MW, aes(x = Edit_Efficiency_Percent, y = fct_relevel(Cell_Type, "K562", "HEK293T", "iPSC"))) +
  geom_point(size =7) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 21)) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 0.8)) +
  theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = 0.8)) +
  theme(axis.ticks.length=unit(.2, "cm")) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(text = element_text(family="Arial", colour = "black", size = 30)) 
ggsave("Edit_Efficiency_MW_BC_Pool_1.jpeg", width = 10, height = 6, path = "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/")
```

```{r}
##Reading in table

MW <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/FigS10_Final_Figure_Datasets/MW_Edit_Scores_Comparison_Table.csv") 

##Select the relevant columns

MW_Matrix <- MW %>% 
  select(K562:iPSC) 

##Convert to matrix and correlate

MW_Matrix <- as.matrix(MW_Matrix)

MW_Corr_Matrix <- cor(MW_Matrix)


##Pivoting data longer for plotting

MW_Corr_DF <- melt(MW_Corr_Matrix) 

MW_Corr_DF <- MW_Corr_DF %>% 
  select(Cell_Type_X = X1, Cell_Type_Y = X2, Corr = value) %>% 
  mutate(Corr = round(Corr, digits = 2))

MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_X <- ordered(MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_X, levels = c("K562", "HEK293T", "iPSC"))

MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_Y <- ordered(MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_Y, levels = c("iPSC", "HEK293T", "K562"))

##Making correlation heatmap 

ggplot(MW_Corr_DF, aes(x = Cell_Type_X, y = Cell_Type_Y, fill = Corr)) +
  geom_tile() 
  ggsave("MW_Cell_Context_Corr_Heatmap_Legend.jpeg", width = 38, height = 2.5, path = "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/")


ggplot(MW_Corr_DF, aes(x = Cell_Type_X, y = Cell_Type_Y, fill = Corr)) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_void() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Corr), color = "white", size = 10) +
  scale_fill_continuous(limits=c(0.5, 1)) +
  theme(axis.ticks.length=unit(0, "cm")) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "") + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(family="Arial", colour = "black", size = 12))
ggsave("MW_Cell_Context_Corr_Heatmap.jpeg", width = 5, height = 4, path = "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/")

```


```{r}
##Individual barcodes in 6x6 individual heatmaps 

MW <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/FigS10_Final_Figure_Datasets/MW_Edit_Scores_Comparison_Table.csv") 

##Spread out variables so each barcode is it's own variable 

iPSC_BC_Correlation <- MW %>% 
  select(ID_Number, BC_Pool, iPSC) %>% 
  filter(iPSC > 0)
iPSC_BC_Correlation <- iPSC_BC_Correlation %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = BC_Pool, values_from = iPSC) 
iPSC_BC_Correlation <- iPSC_BC_Correlation %>% 
  dplyr::rename(iPSC_BC1 = `1`, iPSC_BC2 = `2`)

K562_BC_Correlation <- MW %>% 
  select(ID_Number, BC_Pool, K562) %>% 
  filter(K562 > 0)
K562_BC_Correlation <- K562_BC_Correlation %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = BC_Pool, values_from = K562) 
K562_BC_Correlation <- K562_BC_Correlation %>% 
  dplyr::rename(K562_BC1 = `1`, K562_BC2 = `2`)

HEK293T_BC_Correlation <- MW %>% 
  select(ID_Number, BC_Pool, HEK293T) %>% 
  filter(HEK293T > 0)
HEK293T_BC_Correlation <- HEK293T_BC_Correlation %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = BC_Pool, values_from = HEK293T) 
HEK293T_BC_Correlation <- HEK293T_BC_Correlation %>% 
  dplyr::rename(HEK293T_BC1 = `1`, HEK293T_BC2 = `2`)

MW_BC1_BC2 <- iPSC_BC_Correlation %>% 
  left_join(K562_BC_Correlation, by = "ID_Number")

MW_BC1_BC2 <- MW_BC1_BC2 %>% 
  left_join(HEK293T_BC_Correlation, by = "ID_Number")

##Creating corr matrix to look at range of correlation coefficinents 

MW_Results_Matrix <- MW_BC1_BC2 %>% 
  select(iPSC_BC1, iPSC_BC2, K562_BC1, K562_BC2, HEK293T_BC1, HEK293T_BC2) 

MW_Results_Matrix <- as.matrix(MW_Results_Matrix)

MW_Results_Corr_Matrix <- cor(MW_Results_Matrix, use = "complete.obs")

range(MW_Results_Corr_Matrix, na.rm = TRUE)


##Pivoting data longer for plotting

MW_Corr_DF <- melt(MW_Results_Corr_Matrix) 

MW_Corr_DF <- MW_Corr_DF %>% 
  select(Cell_Type_X = X1, Cell_Type_Y = X2, Corr = value) %>% 
  mutate(Corr = round(Corr, digits = 2))

MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_X <- ordered(MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_X, levels = c("K562_BC1", "K562_BC2", "HEK293T_BC1", "HEK293T_BC2", "iPSC_BC1", "iPSC_BC2"))

MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_Y <- ordered(MW_Corr_DF$Cell_Type_Y, levels = c("iPSC_BC2", "iPSC_BC1", "HEK293T_BC2", "HEK293T_BC1", "K562_BC2", "K562_BC1"))

##Making correlation heatmap 

ggplot(MW_Corr_DF, aes(x = Cell_Type_X, y = Cell_Type_Y, fill = Corr)) +
  geom_tile() 
  ggsave("MW_Cell_Context_Individual_Barcode_Corr_Heatmap_Legend.jpeg", width = 38, height = 2.5, path = "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/")


ggplot(MW_Corr_DF, aes(x = Cell_Type_X, y = Cell_Type_Y, fill = Corr)) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme_void() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Corr), color = "white", size = 10) +
  scale_fill_continuous(limits=c(0, 1)) +
  theme(axis.ticks.length=unit(0, "cm")) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "") + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(family="Arial", colour = "black", size = 10))
ggsave("MW_Cell_Context_Inidividual_Barcode_Corr_Heatmap.jpeg", width = 7, height = 5, path = "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/")

```
